subject: general
question: The 31st South East Asian Games were held in ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vietnam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **31st Southeast Asian Games** were held in Vietnam from May 12 to 23, 2022.
 
• It's the biggest sporting event in Southeast Asia and is a biennial event.
 
• The event was first listed to take place in November 2021 still it was laid over due to the Covid epidemic.
 
• Moto of 31st Southeast Asian Games- “** For a Stronger South East Asia **”

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• In 2023, the Southeast Asian Games will be held in Phnom Penh, Cambodia.
 
• The mascot of the 2021 Southeast Asian Games is “Sao La”, inspired by the saola – a rare mammal native to central Vietnam.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **South East Asian Games:**

 
 
• The Southeast Asian Games( also known as the SEA Games), is a biannual multi-sport event involving actors from the current 11 countries of Southeast Asia.
 
• The games are under the regulation of the Southeast Asian Games Federation with supervision by the International Olympic Committee( IOC) and the Olympic Council of Asia.
